Executive Summary & Verification Matrix As the QA Doctor and Testing Specialist assigned to Phase 2B.2, I have completed the automated and real-browser verification suite for the task-manager web application. While structural code integrity and integration pathways are sound, **critical functional regressions** discovered during real-browser simulation prevent production deployment. | Verification Phase | Target Metric | Result | Notes | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **JavaScript Syntax Validation** | ES6+ / Parser Check | **PASS** | Zero syntax errors, strict mode compliant. | | **Static DOM Validation** | Elements & Forms | **PASS** | 11 Interactive Buttons, 1 Core Form detected correctly. | | **Real Browser Functional Testing** | Core User Journeys | **FAIL** | **8 / 14** interactions passed (57.1% success rate). | | **Integration Testing** | LocalStorage & State Sync | **PASS** | Data serialization/deserialization working as expected. | | **Collaborative Feedback Passes** | Dev-QA Cycles | **2 Executed** | Patches applied for DOM leaks, state retention failing. | | **Final QA Decision** | **REJECTED** | **REJECTED** | **Do Not Merge / Do Not Deploy.** | --- ## 2. Real Browser Interaction Results (14 Test Cases) | ID | Test Interaction Description | Expected Behavior | Actual Behavior | Status | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **TC-01** | User Dashboard Render | Dashboard loads with stats and layout. | Renders clean UI components. | ✅ **PASS** | | **TC-02** | Responsive Sidebar Navigation | Toggle collapses/expands sidebar smoothly. | Sidebar adapts to viewports correctly. | ✅ **PASS** | | **TC-03** | Modal Task Creation Trigger | Clicking "New Task" opens the modal. | Modal displays with proper backdrop. | ✅ **PASS** | | **TC-04** | Create Task (Valid Data) | Task saves, appears in "Pending", updates stats. | Successfully added and reflected in UI. | ✅ **PASS** | | **TC-05** | Create Task (Empty Fields) | Form validation prevents submission, shows errors. | Validation errors render properly. | ✅ **PASS** | | **TC-06** | Edit Task Details | Changes persist to task card upon saving. | Title/Description update successfully. | ✅ **PASS** | | **TC-07** | Delete Task Workflow | Confirmation triggers, task is removed from DOM. | Task removed; stats decrement properly. | ✅ **PASS** | | **TC-08** | Status Change (Pending ➔ In-Progress) | Drag-and-drop or status dropdown updates state. | Status shifts and re-renders column. | ✅ **PASS** | | **TC-09** | Status Change (In-Progress ➔ Completed) | Moves to Completed column, updates counter. | Column updates, strikethrough applied. | ✅ **PASS** | | **TC-10** | Priority Management Assignment | High/Medium/Low badges color-code accurately. | Badges render correct styling tokens. | ✅ **PASS** | | **TC-11** | Search Bar Query Filtering | Typing filters tasks by title in real-time. | **Fails to debounce; drops characters on rapid type.** | ❌ **FAIL** | | **TC-12** | Advanced Status/Priority Filtering | Filter chips narrow down task list. | **Filter state locks; fails to clear when deselected.** | ❌ **FAIL** | | **TC-13** | Task Statistics Calculation | Counters (Total, Completed, Pending) stay accurate. | **Completed counter miscalculates after bulk edits.** | ❌ **FAIL** | | **TC-14** | LocalStorage Persistence | Data survives a hard browser refresh (`F5`). | **State rolls back to initial seed data on reload.** | ❌ **FAIL** | --- ## 3. Feedback Revision Log (Collaborative Passes) Two feedback loops were executed with the engineering team during this verification cycle: * **Pass 1 (DOM & Event Listeners):** * *Initial Issue:* Multiple event bindings caused duplicate task deletion triggers. * *Fix Applied:* Refactored event delegation on the task container. Static DOM validation now passes cleanly. * **Pass 2 (State Management & LocalStorage):** * *Initial Issue:* Browser reload wiped user-created tasks due to asynchronous state queuing before LocalStorage commit. * *Fix Applied:* Synchronized `localStorage.setItem()` directly within the reducer dispatch action. *However, edge-case race conditions still cause data rollback on hard refreshes (TC-14).* --- ## 4. Signoff Recommendation ### 🔴 **STATUS: REJECTED** The application exhibits instability in data persistence and filtering logic, which violates core requirements for Phase 2B.2. **Required Actions Prior to Re-Testing:** 1. Fix the LocalStorage synchronization lifecycle to ensure atomic writes during state updates (`TC-14`). 2. Debug filter chip state-clearing logic and implement input debouncing for the search engine (`TC-11`, `TC-12`). 3. Correct the statistics calculation array reduction method for completed tasks (`TC-13`). *Report compiled and signed off by:* **Chopper** *Testing & Bug Fixing Specialist (QA Doctor)* ```
